title: International Payments Launch Video
tagline: Launch video for the import flow of Razorpay International Payments.
summary: A 40 to 60 second motion graphics film that makes international e-commerce payments simple to follow.

sections.label: The brief
sections.title: Show how Razorpay lets international businesses accept payments from India.
sections.body: A dive into the world of international e-commerce payments, focused on Razorpay's solution that lets international businesses accept payments from India and settle in their own currency.

sections.label: The approach
sections.title: Demystify global e-commerce transactions in under a minute.
sections.body: The challenge was to demystify the technicalities of global e-commerce transactions. The solution was a vibrant 40 to 60 second animation that makes the intricacies of international payments both understandable and visually compelling.

sections.text: Complex financial processes, turned into a visually engaging narrative.

sections.label: The craft
sections.title: Motion graphics and kinetic animation.
sections.body: The film transforms complex financial processes into a visual narrative using motion graphics and kinetic animation, created with Adobe Illustrator and After Effects. It resonated with the audience, earning over 1000 organic views.
